---
name: Bug report
about: A web tool renders, connects, or behaves incorrectly
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

## What happened

A clear description of the wrong behavior, and which tool/page it's on
(inspector, world editor, behavior editor, toon client, web TUI/REPL, trace
analyzer, etc.).

## What you expected

What should have happened instead.

## Reproduction

Steps to trigger it. Include whatever input drove it:

- Page / URL (and any `?server=` or query params):
- Loaded snapshot, or a live server you connected to:
- Action(s) taken in the UI:

## Environment

- Browser + version:
- bunnyland-web commit:
- Connected server image/version, if live:

## Evidence

Console errors, screenshots, failing Playwright output, or a trace artifact.
Paste the actual output rather than describing it.

## Automation (optional)

- [ ] A bot or agent generated or assisted with this report. Noting it is a
      tracing courtesy that helps reproduce the run — it does not change how the
      report is weighed.
